description: The wording and branding of the payment receipt emailed to participants.

fields.description: Placeholders allowed, e.g. Payment receipt - {{ session_title }}. Left blank, the default subject is used.
fields.label: Subject

fields.description: The message above the receipt details. Placeholders allowed - see the list at the bottom. Left blank, the default message is used.
fields.label: Body

fields.description: Small print at the bottom of the email - contact details, terms, a sign-off. Clear it to send the receipt with no footer.
fields.label: Footer

fields.description: Large text in the coloured header, e.g. UCIC 2026. Left blank, the conference name is used.
fields.label: Header Title

fields.description: Shown in the header. Must be a PUBLIC file (untick Is Private when uploading) - mail clients cannot log in to fetch a private one. A white or transparent PNG looks best on a dark brand colour.
fields.label: Logo

fields.description: Header band, dividers and links. Header text turns dark automatically on a light colour.
fields.label: Brand Colour

fields.options:
Write these into the Subject, Body or Footer and they are replaced with the receipt's own values. Wrap optional ones in {% if ... %}...{% endif %} so nothing odd shows when a value is missing.

{{ participant }}Participant's full name
{{ session_title }}Session bought, or e.g. Conference Pass - Both Days
{{ conference }}Conference name
{{ session_date_display }}Session date, e.g. 24 August 2026
{{ venue }}Hall
{{ pass_package }}Conference pass package (passes only)
{{ pass_days_display }}Dates the pass is valid on (passes only)
{{ amount_display }}Amount paid, with currency
{{ paid_on_display }}When it was paid
{{ receipt_no }}Receipt number (the Payment Request)
{{ gateway }}, {{ gateway_reference }}Payment gateway and its transaction reference

Example: {% if participant %}Dear {{ participant }},{% else %}Hello,{% endif %}

Use Preview to check the email before saving, and Send Test Email to see it in your own inbox.
